description: Compare a borrower's existing mortgage against a new rate and report monthly savings, total savings (SGD) and break-even months. Set `mode` to 'original' (supply the original loan amount, tenure and start date) or 'remaining' (supply the current outstanding balance and remaining tenure). Not for finding the new package: use `recommend_packages` for that.

currentRate.description: Annual rate on the existing loan, as a percentage (e.g. 4.0 = 4%).

earlyRedemptionPenalty.description: Penalty the current bank charges for repaying within its lock-in, in SGD; treated as a switching cost like refinancingCosts.

loanStartMonth.description: Mode 'original': month the loan started, as a number (1 = January).

loanStartYear.description: Mode 'original': calendar year the loan started, e.g. 2021.

mode.description: Use 'original' when supplying the loan's original terms and start date, 'remaining' when supplying the current outstanding balance and tenure left.

newRate.description: Annual rate offered on the new loan, as a percentage (e.g. 3.2 = 3.2%).

newTenureYears.description: Tenure of the new loan, in years. Omit to keep the current loan’s remaining tenure.

originalLoanAmount.description: Mode 'original': the amount first borrowed, in SGD. Today's balance is worked out from it.

originalTenureYears.description: Mode 'original': the tenure the loan was first taken over, in years.

refinancingCosts.description: One-off cost of switching (legal and valuation fees), in SGD; deducted from the savings and recouped in the break-even.

remainingAmount.description: Mode 'remaining': the balance still owed today, in SGD.

remainingTenureYears.description: Mode 'remaining': years left to repay on the current loan.

name: calculate_refinance_savings

breakEvenMonths.description: Months to recoup switching costs, or null if it never breaks even.

isBeneficial.description: True if refinancing saves money overall.

newMonthly.description: Monthly instalment after refinancing, in SGD.

remainingBalance.description: Outstanding balance being refinanced, in SGD.

totalCurrentCost.description: Total remaining cost on the current loan, in SGD.

totalNewCost.description: Total cost on the new loan incl. switching costs, in SGD.

totalSavings.description: Net saving over the remaining tenure, in SGD.

warning.description: Set when the loan start/tenure was clamped (e.g. loan already fully repaid).

title: Refinance savings calculator
